description: Dreaming of the Philippines? 🌴✨ Here’s our 2-week itinerary packed with stunning beaches, breathtaking waterfalls, island hopping, and unforgettable underwater adventures. From the hustle and bustle of Manila to the serene turquoise lagoons of El Nido and vibrant coral reefs in Coron, this trip truly has it all! 🏝️🐠 **Day 1 – Manila**   Arrival, explore the city center, and savor some street food. Prepare for an early flight the next morning. **Day 2–3 – Bohol**   Visit Loboc River, relax at Alona Beach, enjoy the stunning Kawasan Falls, marvel at the Chocolate Hills, spot the adorable tarsiers, and experience the sea of clouds. **Day 4–5 – Siquijor**   Discover beautiful beaches, enchanting waterfalls, mysterious caves, and marine sanctuaries while exploring on a scooter. **Day 6 – Dumaguete (Apo Island)**   Enjoy a day trip to Apo Island for snorkeling with turtles. **Day 7–8 – Moalboal (Cebu)**   Join the sardine run, relax on the white beaches, and experience canyoning adventures. **Day 9–11 – Boracay**   Spend days on the beach, take an island tour, zipline, ride ATVs, and catch stunning sunsets. **Day 12–15 – El Nido**   Kayak through lagoons, discover secret beaches, and go on a private island hopping tour. **Day 16–20 – Coron**   Explore Kayangan Lake, Barracuda Lake, Malcapuya Island, soak in hot springs, and unwind before heading home. #Philippines   #TravelItinerary   #IslandHopping   #TropicalTravel   #asiatravel
